create_minhash_config: create a MinhashConfig with HashConfig precision, number of buckets, and hashes per bucket for deduplication
run_slurm_pipeline_executor: run a SlurmPipelineExecutor with a pipeline of readers, dedup stages, and writers on a SLURM cluster
compute_minhash_signatures: compute MinhashDedupSignature for each document in a JsonlReader dataset using a specified language
find_duplicate_buckets: find duplicate matches between minhash signatures using MinhashDedupBuckets across configured buckets
filter_duplicate_clusters: filter documents using MinhashDedupCluster and MinhashDedupFilter to remove all but one sample per duplicate cluster
